title: Span (two disjoint namespaces)
description: An addressable, exactly-reconstructible region of frozen text. The two namespaces are kept apart by a discriminator AND by different ID field names, so mixing them is a schema violation rather than a silent methodological error. EvidenceSpan addresses raw source bytes and is visible to WEBPAGE_P1 and C_REGISTRY only. VisibleMessageSpan addresses the exact researcher_messages bytes that vendor compress_research saw, and is the only namespace C_VISIBLE may select from -- reverse-mapping a model-written page summary back to raw page text would smuggle evidence P0's compressor never had, which is the difference between the compressor-only experiment and the registry-assisted one.

content_hash.description: Snapshot this span is carved from. char offsets index that snapshot's decoded text.

source_occurrence_ids.description: Every occurrence this span is citable through. Must be non-empty: a span with no occurrence is a dangling citation and is a fatal integrity error.

text_sha256.description: Digest of the exact span text. Re-derived at preflight; a mismatch means the offsets no longer address what was selected.

heading_path.description: Breadcrumb of enclosing headings, carried as metadata so the markdown chunker can preserve context without duplicating text via large overlaps.

facet_ids.description: EVALUATOR-ONLY. Gold facet labels, if any. This field MUST be absent from any structure rendered into a selector prompt -- populating it in the treatment view would hand P1 the answer key. The treatment-visible projection strips it.

kind.description: Only TOOL_EVIDENCE may produce a citation or source binding. MODEL_DERIVED_CONTEXT (the researcher's own reasoning, and model-written page summaries) can be retained to preserve plans and gap statements, but is never promoted to source evidence -- and primary quality evidence metrics count TOOL_EVIDENCE only.

visible_compressor_view_hash.description: Hash of the immutable view derived from the exact bytes vendor compress_research received. Ties every selectable span to one provable input state.

source_occurrence_ids.description: Provenance back-edge, permitted only for TOOL_EVIDENCE. It may be used to attribute a citation, never to fetch text absent from the visible bytes.
